summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (buffers only when is_terminal, returns that result, no Windows calls); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy dispatch branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified: tests and Black were not run, per instructions; line lengths were checked by hand (added lines are within 88 columns). Nothing was committed.
